long_biography.plain_text:
Minerva Marine's operating model now extends beyond its tanker base into dry-cargo, gas and container shipping. Separate management companies cover different markets, while technical operations, seafarer training and safety systems provide a common structure across the privately held group.

Andreas Ioannis Martinos leads that second-generation organisation as Minerva's principal. He joined the family company in the early 2000s, became its managing director and later controlled its London affiliate. In the principal role, he oversees a group serving multiple cargo markets while retaining private family direction. The transition leaves his father as founder and owner while placing operating authority with the next generation.
